content.question: What is Elastic Net regularization?
options: A weighted linear combination of the L1- and L2-penalty terms, combining their properties.
A technique that alternates between L1 and L2 penalties at each training epoch.
A special case of L2-regularization with a fixed hyperparameter of 1.
A method that applies L1 to numerical features and L2 to categorical features.
content.answer: A weighted linear combination of the L1- and L2-penalty terms, combining their properties.
